cards.1025: THE BACK BEDROOM AT TWELVE, UPSTAIRS, WITH A SMALL TABLE UNDER THE WINDOW, A CHAIR WITH AN APRON OVER THE BACK OF IT AND A BED AGAINST THE OTHER WALL. THE MOTHER CAME DOWN THE RIVER AND HAS BEEN SLEEPING THERE AND CAME BACK FROM A YARD ON HER OWN TWO HANDS AT THE END OF 1024. ASK: SHE HAS THE FIGURE IN THE APRON AND HE HAS TOLD HER TO BRING IT WHEN HE STARTS, AND HE HAS COME TO SAY HE IS STARTING. WHAT IS IN THE WAY: THE JOB WANTS TWO MEN AND HE HAS NOT GOT TWO MEN, AND THE ONE PERSON HE ASKED TO BE IN THE HOUSE HAS NOT ANSWERED, SO A FORTNIGHT OF A MAN'S TIME HAS NO BEGINNING ON IT, AND HE IS ABOUT TO BE PAID FOR WORK HE CANNOT YET PUT A DATE TO. DECISION: HE TELLS HER ALL OF THAT AND TAKES THE MONEY ANYWAY, BECAUSE A MAN WHO HAS NOT TAKEN THE MONEY CANNOT BEGIN EITHER AND THE NOT-BEGINNING IS WHAT HAS COST HIM THE WHOLE WINTER. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: HE IS PAID OUT OF AN APRON IN A ROOM AT THE BACK OF HER OWN HOUSE, AND THERE IS NOWHERE IN THIS BOROUGH FOR THAT TO GO. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: THE FIGURE IS IN HIS POCKET, THE FORTNIGHT HAS BEGUN, AND THE WALL HAS NOT BEEN TOUCHED.
cards.1026: THE SISTER'S OWN ROOM AT TEN, AT THE FRONT OF THE LANDING, WITH A SINGLE WINDOW AND A CHAIR PULLED OUT FROM THE WALL. HE ASKED HER AT 1023 TO BE THERE ON THE DAY HE STARTS AND SHE HAS NOT ANSWERED AND HE HAS NOW BEEN PAID, WHICH MEANS HE HAS TO ASK AGAIN. ASK: HE ASKS HER FOR THE ANSWER SHE HAS NOT GIVEN HIM. WHAT IS IN THE WAY: SHE IS NOT GOING TO STAND IN A ROOM FOR A MAN SHE CANNOT NAME THE PAYER OF, BECAUSE SHE HAS BEEN ON THAT BOOK LONGER THAN HE HAS BEEN ALIVE AND SHE KNOWS WHAT A ROOM IS FOR. DECISION: HE DOES NOT TELL HER WHOSE MONEY IT IS, AND SHE SEES THAT HE HAS NOT AND DOES NOT PUSH, AND SHE AGREES ANYWAY. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: HE HAS FOUND THE FIRST PERSON ON THAT FRONTAGE WHO WILL STAND IN A ROOM ON HIS WORD ALONE, AND HE DID NOT EARN IT AND HE KNOWS HE DID NOT. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: A WOMAN THERE NOW KNOWS THERE IS A FIGURE HE CANNOT PUT A NAME TO, AND HE HAS BEGUN TO CARRY SOMETHING, WHICH IS WHAT BEING PAID MEANS.
cards.1027: THE SOUTH SIDE OF THE KERB ROUND THE WEIGH PIT AT THE UNIT, WHERE FOUR FEET OF BRICK CAME OUT OF ITS BED AND THE BED WAS OPENED OUT TO THE BOTTOM A FORTNIGHT AGO AND NOBODY AT THAT YARD HAS BEEN TOLD. HE IS ALONE AND HIS HANDS ARE FULL OF HIS OWN MONEY. ASK: NOTHING IS ASKED OF ANYBODY. WHAT CARRIES IT INSTEAD: A FORTNIGHT IN WHICH A MAN IS PAID AND THE MONEY CANNOT GO INTO HIS OWN YARD, AND A FAULT IN THAT YARD THAT IS NOW OPEN TO THE BOTTOM AND HAS A PLATE LIPPING OVER ONE CORNER OF IT. DECISION: HE TAKES THE PLATE OFF AND STANDS IT INSIDE HIS OWN STORE AND TELLS NOBODY, AND HE WILL NOT PUT HER MONEY INTO HIS OWN KERB, AND HE DECIDES TO CARRY THE FAULT TO THAT OTHER YARD AND OFFER IT OUT LOUD. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: THE ONLY DANGEROUS THING IN THAT YARD IS NOW A HOLE ANYBODY CAN PUT A BOOT THROUGH, AND HE HAS SAID IT TO HIMSELF THAT HE WILL TELL SOMEBODY, WHICH HE HAS SAID TWICE BEFORE. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: A MAN GOING UP A YARD HE HAS BEEN TURNED AWAY FROM FOUR TIMES CARRYING THE ONE THING HE HAS NEVER TOLD ANYBODY.
cards.1028: THE OFFICE AT THE LOCK-UP, WITH A DESK, A BOOK, ONE COLUMN RULED DOWN IT AND A NEW ROW RULED UNDER THE SHUT ONE WAITING FOR A SEASON THAT HAS NOT OPENED. THE WOMAN WHO KEEPS THAT BOOK IS IN IT. ASK: HE OFFERS HER THE FOUR FEET OF BRICK OUT OF THE KERB WITH ITS BED OPENED TO THE BOTTOM, DONE BY HIMSELF ON HIS OWN TIME AND TOLD TO NOBODY, AND HE OFFERS IT SO THAT IT WILL BE PUT DOWN SOMEWHERE. WHAT STANDS AGAINST IT: A COLUMN TAKES WORK SOMEBODY ASKED FOR AND HE ASKED FOR IT, SO THE ONE FAULT HE HAS EVER KEEN TO HIMSELF CANNOT GO ON IT EITHER, AND SHE GIVES HIM THE RULE IN ONE SENTENCE AND DOES NOT SOFTEN IT. DECISION: HE STOPS BEING ASKED FOR, AND ASKS HER INSTEAD WHAT A WOMAN HAS TO DO TO GET A JOB PUT DOWN AGAINST HER OWN HOUSE. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: HE BROUGHT THE ONLY THING HE HAS NEVER TOLD ANYBODY AND HE TAKES IT HOME WITH HIM. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: HE KNOWS WHAT THE MOTHER AT TWELVE WENT OUT OF HER FRONT DOOR ON HER OWN TWO HANDS TO TRY TO DO, AND HE WILL NOT ASK HER WHETHER SHE DID IT.
cards.1029: THE TOP OF THAT STAIR AT NUMBER NINE, WHERE THERE IS A WINDOW AND NO DOOR OFF IT, SO THAT A PERSON STANDS IN A LANDING A FOOT AND A HALF WIDE. THE WOMAN OF THAT HOUSE CAME OFF THE BOOK WHEN THE SEASON SHUT. ASK: NOTHING. IT IS THE FIRST TIME HE HAS COME UP THAT FRONTAGE WITH NOTHING TO ASK FOR, AND SHE MAKES HIM SAY SO OUT LOUD BEFORE SHE WILL HEAR ANYTHING ELSE. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: THE WHOLE OF IT IS NOW IN TWO HEADS INSTEAD OF ONE, AND HE IS THE ONLY PERSON ON THAT FRONTAGE WHO IS GETTING NOTHING BACK.
cards.1030: THE SCULLERY AT NUMBER TEN, WITH A SILL LAID OVER ITS FLAGS AT THE BACK DOOR AND A BOTTOM RAIL SPLIT ALONG ITS LENGTH. THE WOMAN OF THAT HOUSE ASKS HIM FOR SOMETHING FOR THE FIRST TIME IN THE WHOLE OF THIS. ASK: SHE ASKS HIM TO DO HER BACK DOOR. WHAT STANDS AGAINST IT: HE CANNOT TAKE IT FOR NOTHING, BECAUSE HE HAS BEEN PAID TWICE INSIDE A FORTNIGHT, AND NOTHING GETS PUT RIGHT ANYWAY, AND SHE HERSELF WONNOT HAVE IT DONE FOR NOTHING BECAUSE SHE HAS HAD TWO MEN IN THAT STREET IN SIX YEARS WHO WOULD NOT TAKE A SHILLING OFF HER. DECISION: HE ASKS HER WHAT IT COSTS HER, OUT LOUD, IN WORDS, THE WAY HE ASKED THE MOTHER AT TWELVE, AND SHE HAS NEVER HAD TO find OUT AND CANNOT. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: HE HAS CARRIED THE HABIT OF ASKING A WOMAN FOR A FIGURE INTO A HOUSE WHERE IT DOES NOT APPLY AND IT HAS COST HER NOTHING AND HIM THE ONE JOB HE COULD HAVE DONE. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: SHE IS GOING TO HAVE TO FIND OUT WHAT A THING COSTS HER, AND SHE HAS NEVER PAID ANYBODY FOR ANYTHING, AND THAT IS THE FIRST THING HE HAS PUT INTO A WOMAN THAT SHE DID NOT ASK HIM FOR.
cards.1031: THE FLOOR UNDER THE LADDER IN THE STORE AT THE UNIT, WITH HIS OWN RACK STANDING ON IT ON THREE FEET, TWO OF WHICH CARRY AND ONE OF WHICH DOES NOT. HE IS ALONE AND THERE IS NOBODY TO ASK HIM ANYTHING. ASK: NOTHING. WHAT CARRIES IT INSTEAD: THE ONE PART OF THAT FORTNIGHT WHICH ONE MAN CAN FINISH BY HIMSELF, WHICH IS A TRAY, AND FOUR FEET OF DEAL THAT HAVE BEEN OFF THE BOTTOM OF HIS OWN STACK SINCE A FORTNIGHT AGO. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: THE STACK ABOVE THE CUT HAS ALREADY BEGUN TO COME ACROSS INTO THE GAP, AND HE HAS HAD TO PUT HIS BEST TIMBER UNDER A RANGE FOR A WOMAN WHO WILL STAND NEXT TO IT IN A ROOM AND NOT TOUCH IT. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: HE HAS THE ONLY THING IN THE FORTNIGHT HE CAN FINISH, AND NO WAY OF PUTTING A RANGE ON IT, BECAUSE THE JOB WANTS TWO MEN WHO ARE NOT HIM.
cards.1032: THE DAUGHTER'S OWN ROOM AT TWELVE, OVER THE LANDING AND AT THE BACK, WITH A WINDOW SHUT DOWN TO A SLOT AND A CHAIR BESIDE THE BED, WHICH IS EMPTY BECAUSE THE DAUGHTER IS AT THE BOOK ON A DAY THAT YARD IS WORKING. THE MOTHER IS IN IT. ASK: SHE ASKS HIM FOR THE ONE THING SHE HAS WANTED SINCE HE CAME UP THAT FRONTAGE, WHICH IS NOT THE WALL, AND WHICH IS TO KNOW WHETHER THE NAME ON A PIECE OF PAPER IN A FOLDED SQUARE IN HER APRON IS IN THAT YARD'S BOOK. WHAT IS IN THE WAY: HE CANNOT FIND OUT AND NEVER COULD, BECAUSE A NAME GOES ON A PAGE AGAINST WORK SOMEBODY ASKED FOR AND THAT SQUARE IS NOT WORK, AND THE WOMAN WHOSE NAME IT IS DEAD. DECISION: HE DOES NOT REACH FOR IT AND DOES NOT TELL HER HE CANNOT FIND OUT, AND HE SAYS HE WILL. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: HE HAS UNDERTAKEN THE FIRST THING FOR ANYBODY THAT IS NOT WORK AND IS NOT MONEY AND CANNOT BE DONE. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: HIS OWN NAME AND HER MOTHER'S ARE BOTH IN HIS HEAD AND BOTH ON NOTHING, AND HE IS THE ONLY PERSON WHO KNOWS BOTH.
cards.1033: THE LITTLE STORE AT THE LOCK-UP, WITH A SHELF PUT ACROSS ITS FLOOR, ONE HIGH WINDOW AND A DOOR STANDING OPEN. HE IS NOT IN THE OFFICE AND SHE IS NOT IN THAT ROOM AND HE IS THERE BECAUSE A MAN WHO HAS BEEN PAID HAS TO GO AND TELL SOMEBODY, AND THE ONLY BUILDERS' YARD WITH A DOOR OPEN ON IT. ASK: HE TELLS HER HE HAS STARTED AND THAT HE HAS BEEN PAID OUT OF HER OWN HAND, WHICH IS THE FIRST TIME HE HAS PUT THAT INTO WORDS TO HER. WHAT STANDS AGAINST IT: SHE IS NOT HAVING IT BECAUSE SHE NEVER ASKED FOR IT, AND SHE GIVES THE ONE REASON SHE HAS FOR EVERYTHING SHE HAS REFUSED HIM, WHICH IS THAT A PAGE TAKES WHAT SOMEBODY ASKS FOR. DECISION: HE DOES NOT ARGUE WITH HER. WHAT IT COSTS HIM: THE ONE THING HE HAS GONE BACK TO THAT YARD FOR TWICE IS REFUSED FOR A DIFFERENT REASON AND HE IS GRATEFUL FOR IT. WHAT IT LEAVES DIFFERENT: SHE ASKS HIM A QUESTION, WHICH SHE HAS NEVER DONE, AND HE CANNOT ANSWER IT, AND SHE LETS HIM OUT OF IT WITHOUT ONE.
cards.1034: THE ROOM OVER THE KITCHEN AT NUMBER NINE, WHICH HAS A WINDOW GIVING ON THE BACK YARD AND NOTHING IN IT BUT A CHAIR, AND WHICH IS THE ONE ROOM IN THAT HOUSE WHERE NOBODY PUTS A QUESTION TO HER. ten_hands_allocated_and_what_each_one_do.1028: TO KEEP STILL. He lays both hands flat along the front edge of that desk and leaves them there for the whole of it, because he cannot say a sentence about the only fault he has ever kept to himself with his hands anywhere on it.
